summary: Certified MODEL-PSR-WORLDWISE-ALTERNATING satisfies the existing existence-PSR and soundness conditions and has a necessary particular bearer, yet violates one invariant explanation token for that bearer; existing MODEL-PSR-INTRINSIC satisfies the stable-reason alternative. Verified both the stable-to-worldwise implication and a converse conditional on a real existence witness and cross-world reason invariance, plus an incompatibility rule for disjoint reasons. Relative to rigid token identities and a universal two-world frame only; metaphysical explanatory adequacy, reason identity and any classical-theist inference remain open. See docs/modal-quantifier-shift-models.md and #465. Follow-up #312 inventory at main 928ae43e: inspected existence-PSR, soundness and stable-explanation dossiers and exact Lean types. BruteFoundationExplanations.necessaryReasonAndNecessitation already derives necessity of one selected existent from NecessaryReasonAt and NecessitatesExistenceAt; its contingentExcludesNecessaryNecessitatingReason supplies their incompatibility with actual contingency. abstractReasonCoverageInsufficient preserves necessary abstract reason truth and sound memberwise explanatory coverage without a necessary concrete individual. HistoryContrastive distinguishes necessary nondiscriminating from contingent discriminating reasons under unchanged ontology; SelectedEffectBridge distinguishes same act/local output uniqueness from cross-world output stability. Reject a new collapse theorem that merely repackages these existing bridges: existence-PSR covers individuals, not arbitrary truths, and neither necessity of a reason, stability of a reason token, nor necessary existence of its bearer follows from that scope. These profiles have different reason sorts and are not silently identified. Decisive open burdens remain sufficient explanation necessitates its effect, every relevant selected reason is necessary, existence facts exhaust the claimed collapse scope, and actual applicability/adequacy. Nonnecessitating explanation and contingent full reasons remain distinct surviving replies. No new source reading, theorem, claim, premise or root closure; retained all 63 root premises and route costs 31/32/36/38/39/39/40/41. Exact reuse and rival map appended to docs/psr-scope-countermodels.md.
